Respondent/s

 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Sanjay Kumar, Adv.
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Md. Khurshid Alam (Aag-12)
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The present writ petition has been filed seeking direction to the respondent to pay the amount of compensation as per the MVR with effect from 01.04.2003 and suitable compensation to be paid at the rate of Rs.10,000/- instead of Rs.9,500/- per decimal.

3. Counsel for the petitioner and the State both agreed on this point that land acquisition has been made and the petitioner has filed representation in this regard before the District Land Acquisition Officer, Arwal as well as to the District Magistrate, Arwal.
The only dispute is relating to price Patna High Court CWJC No. 2680 of 2023(2) dt.12-07-2023 of the land.

4. Counsel for the petitioner further submits that the representation of the petitioner is pending before the District Magistrate, Arwal which is Annexure-9, but no decision has been taken as yet.
